3. Refusing/evading or failing to do a drug test after notification is prohibited
4. Committing Three Whereabouts Failures (Filing Failures or Missed Tests) in 12 months is prohibited
6. Possession of Prohibited Substances and/or Prohibited Methods is prohibited
7. Trafficking in any Prohibited Substance or Prohibited Method is prohibited
8. Administering to an athlete a prohibited method or substance, assisting, encouraging, aiding, abetting, covering up is prohibited

9. Complicity or attempted complicity – involvement in a rule violation committed by another person such as helping to cover up the violation or avoid detection is prohibited and is sanctioned in the same way as the violation

10. Prohibited association – associating with a person such as a coach, doctor or physic who has been found guilty of a violation or equivalent offence to a doping violation is prohibited and will be sanctioned with a ban of up to 2 years
